unit_definitions.gpu_hours: Physical GPU device-hours within named hardware class; classes are not throughput-equivalent.
unit_definitions.cpu_core_hours: CPU-only HPC/data processing core-hours, excluding CPUs included in GPU nodes.
unit_definitions.facility_design_mw: Nameplate IT power times an assumed 1.20 facility-overhead proxy; not an engineered peak connection requirement or observed annual power draw.
unit_definitions.effective_mit_demand_units: Sum of assumed member-level demand intensity weights against one MIT reference workload; not a count of MIT-sized institutions.
unit_definitions.reference_equivalent_gpu_hours: 2026-era reference device-hours for the same modeled work; sensitivity factors are illustrative and do not prove workload-specific speedup.
unit_definitions.facility_target_mw: 25 MW of total facility design/input power, confirmed by user on 2026-10-04. IT design capacity is 25 MW divided by assumed PUE.

accounting_rule: Each modeled GPU-hour belongs to one mutually exclusive compute activity. Biomedical and robotics are nonadditive tags; coding and agents are an inference subtype with distinct usage allocation, not a second count of the same request.

model_inputs.geography_planning_assumption: Closed-loop robotics/instrument control remains at device or campus. Restricted human/clinical data may use an isolated secure environment in a US consortium-owned facility only when the dataset agreement, responsible institution, and security review allow it; otherwise keep the workload at its originating institution. Other eligible workloads use the US shared facility. No location share is quantified without project-tagged hours.
